triangulate_tracks: triangulate normalized 2D tracks across multiple views using LORANSAC with local refinement
triangulate_by_pair: triangulate 3D points from pairwise camera extrinsics and normalized 2D track correspondences
init_BA: initialize bundle adjustment by optimizing 3D points and camera parameters for an init pair
global_BA: run global bundle adjustment on triangulated points, tracks, and inlier masks across all frames
refine_pose: refine camera extrinsics and intrinsics using pose refinement with reprojection error inliers
